newsitem.title: USA: Md. highway funds at risk over emissions test.
newsitem.headline: Md. highway funds at risk over emissions test.

text.p: Maryland Gov. Parris Glendening said he has not decided whether to keep the state's controversial auto emissions test voluntary, a move federal regulators said would halt $90 million in aid.

Environmental Protection Agency officials have warned the governor that if the test is not made mandatory they would impose sanctions that could hold up the federal funds, which are earmarked for highway construction.
But the state legislature passed a bill defying the EPA and keeping the test voluntary, and Glendening is considering whether to sign.
